title: JFrog Artifactory: 2 flaws used in attacks; attackers can gain admin rights
verdictReason: Attacks are confirmed. The vulnerability is 87 days old, so many systems are likely still unpatched. Ready-made attack tools are public.

category.label: Developer tools
category.why: It holds source code and the keys used to build and ship software.
category.doThis: Patch it. If it faced the internet, change the keys and passwords stored in it.

summary: JFrog Artifactory contains an incorrect authorization vulnerability that leads to a privilege escalation attack due to a validation check of the token signature/issuer and not the token’s scope.
fix: CISA's instruction: apply the vendor's fix, or stop using the product if no fix exists. The deadline CISA set for US federal agencies, Sep 25, 2026, has passed. It is a US government deadline; use it as a guide.
